# A cached test result needs no archive, so its package's compile is a lazy
# hit. The hit must not run the compiler again.

go test -x ./p
stderr 'compile'

go test -x ./p
stdout '\(cached\)'
! stderr 'tool compile'

-- go.mod --
module example.com/lazy

go 1.27
-- p/p.go --
package p

func Add(a, b int) int { return a + b }
-- p/p_test.go --
package p

import "testing"

func TestAdd(t *testing.T) {
	if Add(1, 2) != 3 {
		t.Fatal("1+2 != 3")
	}
}
